Elements.Text: <color=#00000000>缩进</color>EasyDocument is a Unity UI document browsing plugin based on TextMeshPro. A document is a folder shell under StreamingAssets, containing a document.json data file and image assets. The plugin renders multi-level titles, body text, images and image captions with an adaptive layout, and all styles are configured by a ScriptableObject.

<color=#00000000>缩进</color>Support six element types: TITLE_1 to TITLE_4, BODY and IMAGE. Image display size can be specified in pixels inside the json, or auto-fitted by aspect ratio. Layout is fully adaptive: text blocks stretch by content, images scale proportionally, and the Content height grows with the document. Data loading uses dual channels: File on Editor/PC and UnityWebRequest on Android.

<color=#00000000>缩进</color>The plugin is layered from bottom to top: data layer (folder shell), loading layer (EasyDocumentHandler dual-channel), model layer (DataModel + JsonUtility), config layer (EasyDocumentSetting SO), and display layer (EasyDocumentController building the UI).

<color=#00000000>缩进</color>EasyDocumentController.Init(folderName) triggers loading: EasyDocumentHandler reads document.json, EasyDocumentJsonTool parses it into EasyDocumentDataModel, then each element is instantiated from the configured block prefabs into the ScrollView Content, applying styles from EasyDocumentSetting. Images are loaded asynchronously and displayed with the size from json.

<color=#00000000>缩进</color>Create a folder under StreamingAssets/EasyDocumentData, e.g. MyDocument, put document.json inside, and keep image files under the images sub-folder referenced by relative paths.

<color=#00000000>缩进</color>Create an EasyDocumentSetting asset via Assets/Create/WPZ0325/Create SO/EasyDocument/EasyDocumentSetting. Drag an SDF font into FontAsset (optional), and tune colors, font sizes, font styles, alignments, block spacing, paddings and image ratio.

<color=#00000000>缩进</color>Drag the Scroll View-EasyDocument prefab into the scene (or attach EasyDocumentController to any ScrollRect), fill _setting and _documentFolderName in the Inspector, then call Init. You can also right-click the component and choose InitByInspector to preview.
<color=#00000000>缩进</color>After modifying the json or image files, call Init again to refresh the document content at runtime without restarting the application.

<color=#00000000>缩进</color>Each element in the Elements list has a Type field. Text types (TITLE_1 to TITLE_4, BODY) use the Text field; the IMAGE type uses ImagePath for the relative image path, Caption for the image title, and optional ImageWidth/ImageHeight (pixels, 0 or omitted means auto-fit).
<color=#00000000>缩进</color>TITLE_1: chapter title. TITLE_2: section title. TITLE_3: sub-section title. TITLE_4: paragraph title. BODY: normal paragraph. IMAGE: image block with caption.

<color=#00000000>缩进</color>TMP rich text works directly inside the Text field. For a first-line indent, prepend a transparent placeholder: <color=#00000000>缩进</color> or use the space tag: <space=40px>.
<space=40px>This paragraph is indented by 40 pixels using the space tag. The indentation only applies to the first line, exactly like a Word first-line indent.
